# WCNR Congress

> A resource hub for WordPress basics and site management documentation.

WCNR Congress provides foundational guidance on WordPress configuration and page management. The site features practical examples and getting-started resources for users building and maintaining WordPress sites.

## Key Topics

- WordPress basics
- getting started
- page management
- site configuration
- XYZ Doohickey Company
- documentation

## Getting Started

- [Sample Page](https://www.wcnr-congress.org/sample-page): WordPress basics guide featuring XYZ Doohickey Company example
